sentences.l2: 随着限塑令在多个城市逐步推进，人们开始重新审视日常消费中与塑料有关的细节。
sentences.l1: As the plastic restriction order is gradually rolled out in many cities, people have begun to re-examine the plastic-related details of daily consumption.

sentences.l2: 过去，许多消费者习惯于在超市购买商品时顺手索取一次性塑料袋，也习惯在外卖和饮品店使用塑料杯和塑料吸管。
sentences.l1: In the past, many consumers were used to casually asking for disposable plastic bags when buying goods at the supermarket, and were also used to using plastic cups and plastic straws for takeout and at drink shops.

sentences.l2: 这些看似方便的选择，却会在短时间内变成难以降解的垃圾。
sentences.l1: These seemingly convenient choices, however, turn into hard-to-degrade garbage within a short time.

sentences.l2: 近年来，越来越多人选择随身携带环保袋和可重复使用的水杯，把减少塑料用量变成一种生活方式。
sentences.l1: In recent years, more and more people have chosen to carry reusable shopping bags and reusable water bottles with them, turning reducing plastic use into a way of life.

sentences.l2: 环保袋不仅能反复清洗、长期使用，还能承载更重的物品；可重复使用的水杯则让人们在通勤、上课和旅行时随时补水，避免频繁购买瓶装饮料。
sentences.l1: Reusable shopping bags can not only be washed repeatedly and used for a long time, but can also carry heavier items; reusable water bottles let people hydrate at any time while commuting, attending class and traveling, avoiding frequent purchases of bottled drinks.

sentences.l2: 虽然改变习惯需要时间和提醒，但当这种选择逐渐融入家庭、校园与办公场所，它便不再只是个人行为，而成为推动城市可持续发展的重要力量。
sentences.l1: Although changing habits takes time and reminders, once this choice gradually blends into homes, campuses and workplaces, it is no longer merely an individual act, but becomes an important force promoting the sustainable development of cities.
